data.narrative:
Mara is a Pre-Seed stage company in the Defense & Security sector, having raised $1.6M to date. The broader peer universe includes 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, with top private comparables including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method: Stage-Progression. This approach uses a $300M total raised proxy as the baseline, applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Pre-Seed to next-stage advancement in frontier defense technology. This methodology yields an implied valuation of $750M. A Peer-Median approach could not be applied; while 21 same-sector peers exist, the narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, similar-tier) identified insufficient datapoints—zero at the same stage—to support reliable triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $638M to $862M, with a median of $750M. This range reflects the step-up multiplier applied to the raised-capital proxy and incorporates reasonable bounds around the single quantifiable method. The primary uncertainty stems from reliance on a single valuation method and the absence of direct peer comparables at Mara's stage in Defense & Security. The $300M baseline itself warrants scrutiny relative to actual reported metrics should additional financial data become available.
